Ellen (PM): Quick one from testing: the help sidecar label says 'Model alias' but our docs consistently use 'Model version'. Users get confused in the route editor. Do we prefer alias or version?
Noah (Design): 'Model alias' was meant to be friendlier, but 'Model version' is more precise. I'm leaning toward matching docs: use 'Model version' in the help panel header.
Priya (Docs): Docs team prefers 'Model version' too. If we change UI, can we add a short parenthetical for a transition: 'Model version (aka model alias)' inside the sidecar body instead of the control label?
Sam (DevEx): That's reasonable. We should avoid long control labels. Sidecar body is fine. Also we need to ensure any anchor links to the docs use the canonical path `/docs/glossary#model-version`. Is that anchor live?
docs-bot: docs deploy preview: https://deploy-preview/912 contains updated glossary anchor `model-version`.
Noah (Design): UX note: if we add '(aka model alias)' in the body, make it collapsible on mobile to avoid wrapping the header. Use a small disclosure chevron labeled 'Why this name?'.
Priya (Docs): I'll draft the sidecar copy: "Model version: the exact model binary used for inference. Previously surfaced in the UI as 'Model alias'. See Glossary: Model version and Serving: version pinning." Links: `/docs/glossary#model-version`, `/docs/serving/versioning#pinning`.
Sam (DevEx): Implementation checklist: 1) change sidecar heading to 'Model version'; 2) add collapsible note with previous name; 3) ensure internal SPA nav supports hash anchors; 4) update telemetry label from `model_alias_selected` to `model_version_selected` and keep a compatibility shim for analytics.
Ellen (PM): decision: align to 'Model version' in help panel and docs; keep short control label unchanged for now to avoid layout churn; include a collapsible 'Why this name?' note in the sidecar linking to the glossary and versioning docs. Owners: Priya (docs) update copy, Noah (design) update mock for mobile disclosure, Sam (devex) implement anchor handling + telemetry rename.
Priya (Docs): I'll open a docs PR with the glossary anchor and short sidecar copy. ETA 48h.
Noah (Design): I'll post updated mock by EOD with mobile disclosure behavior.
Sam (DevEx): I'll schedule the telemetry rename and add SPA anchor support in the next sprint.
Ellen (PM): Great. One more a11y ask: make the disclosure button keyboard-focusable and use `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls`. We'll verify in staging. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
